name: typebot-as-a-service
description: Plataforma de automação de atendimento WhatsApp como serviço

scripts.docker:logs:typebot: docker compose --env-file .env -f docker-compose.yml logs -f --tail=100 typebot-builder typebot-viewer
scripts.docker:logs:chatwoot: docker compose --env-file .env -f docker-compose.yml logs -f --tail=100 chatwoot chatwoot-worker
scripts.chatwoot:prepare: docker compose --env-file .env -f docker-compose.yml exec chatwoot bundle exec rails db:chatwoot_prepare
